chapters: And Havayah spoke to Moshe in the wilderness of Sinai, in the Tent of Meeting, on the first of the second month, in the second year of their going out from the land of Mitzrayim, saying:
Take the sum of all the congregation of the children of Yisroel, by their families, by their fathers' house, by the number of names, every male by their heads.
From twenty years old and above, all who go out to the army in Yisroel, you shall count them by their hosts, you and Aharon.
And with you shall be a man, a man for a tribe, a man who is head of his fathers' house.
And these are the names of the men who shall stand with you: for Reuven, Elitzur son of Shede'ur.
For Shimon, Shelumiel son of Tzurishadai.
For Yehudah, Nachshon son of Aminadav.
For Yissachar, Netanel son of Tzuar.
For Zevulun, Eliav son of Chelon.
For the sons of Yosef: for Efrayim, Elishama son of Amihud; for Menasheh, Gamliel son of Pedatzur.
For Binyamin, Avidan son of Gidoni.
For Dan, Achiezer son of Amishadai.
For Asher, Pagiel son of Ochran.
For Gad, Elyasaf son of De'uel.
For Naftali, Achira son of Einan.
These are the called ones of the congregation, princes of the tribes of their fathers, heads of the thousands of Yisroel.
And Moshe and Aharon took these men, who were designated by name.

And they assembled all the congregation on the first of the second month, and they registered themselves by their families, by their fathers' house, by the number of names, from twenty years old and above, by their heads.
As Havayah commanded Moshe, so he counted them in the wilderness of Sinai.

And the sons of Reuven, firstborn of Yisroel, their descendants, by their families, by their fathers' house, by the number of names, by their heads, every male from twenty years old and above, all who go out to the army.
Their counted ones, for the tribe of Reuven, forty-six thousand and five hundred.

For the sons of Shimon, their descendants, by their families, by their fathers' house, their counted ones, by the number of names, by their heads, every male from twenty years old and above, all who go out to the army.
Their counted ones, for the tribe of Shimon, fifty-nine thousand and three hundred.
For the sons of Gad, their descendants, by their families, by their fathers' house, by the number of names, from twenty years old and above, all who go out to the army.
Their counted ones, for the tribe of Gad, forty-five thousand six hundred and fifty.
For the sons of Yehudah, their descendants, by their families, by their fathers' house, by the number of names, from twenty years old and above, all who go out to the army.
Their counted ones, for the tribe of Yehudah, seventy-four thousand and six hundred.
For the sons of Yissachar, their descendants, by their families, by their fathers' house, by the number of names, from twenty years old and above, all who go out to the army.
Their counted ones, for the tribe of Yissachar, fifty-four thousand and four hundred.
For the sons of Zevulun, their descendants, by their families, by their fathers' house, by the number of names, from twenty years old and above, all who go out to the army.
Their counted ones, for the tribe of Zevulun, fifty-seven thousand and four hundred.
For the sons of Yosef, for the sons of Efrayim, their descendants, by their families, by their fathers' house, by the number of names, from twenty years old and above, all who go out to the army.
Their counted ones, for the tribe of Efrayim, forty thousand and five hundred.
For the sons of Menasheh, their descendants, by their families, by their fathers' house, by the number of names, from twenty years old and above, all who go out to the army.
Their counted ones, for the tribe of Menasheh, thirty-two thousand and two hundred.
For the sons of Binyamin, their descendants, by their families, by their fathers' house, by the number of names, from twenty years old and above, all who go out to the army.
Their counted ones, for the tribe of Binyamin, thirty-five thousand and four hundred.
For the sons of Dan, their descendants, by their families, by their fathers' house, by the number of names, from twenty years old and above, all who go out to the army.
Their counted ones, for the tribe of Dan, sixty-two thousand and seven hundred.
For the sons of Asher, their descendants, by their families, by their fathers' house, by the number of names, from twenty years old and above, all who go out to the army.
Their counted ones, for the tribe of Asher, forty-one thousand and five hundred.
For the sons of Naftali, their descendants, by their families, by their fathers' house, by the number of names, from twenty years old and above, all who go out to the army.
Their counted ones, for the tribe of Naftali, fifty-three thousand and four hundred.
These are the counted ones whom Moshe and Aharon and the princes of Yisroel counted, twelve men, each man for his fathers' house.
And all the counted ones of the children of Yisroel by their fathers' house were, from twenty years old and above, all who go out to the army in Yisroel.
And all the counted ones were six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty.
And the Leviim, by the tribe of their fathers, were not counted among them.
And Havayah spoke to Moshe, saying:
Only the tribe of Levi you shall not count, and you shall not take their sum among the children of Yisroel.

And you, appoint the Leviim over the Tabernacle of the Testimony, and over all its vessels, and over all that belongs to it; they shall carry the Tabernacle and all its vessels, and they shall minister to it, and around the Tabernacle they shall encamp.
And when the Tabernacle journeys, the Leviim shall take it down, and when the Tabernacle encamps, the Leviim shall set it up; and the stranger who approaches shall be put to death.
And the children of Yisroel shall encamp, a man in his camp, and a man by his banner, by their hosts.

And the Leviim shall encamp around the Tabernacle of the Testimony, and there shall be no wrath upon the congregation of the children of Yisroel, and the Leviim shall guard the charge of the Tabernacle of the Testimony.
And the children of Yisroel did according to all that Havayah commanded Moshe, so they did.
And Havayah spoke to Moshe and to Aharon, saying:
Each man by his banner, with the signs of their fathers' house, the children of Yisroel shall encamp; at a distance around the Tent of Meeting they shall encamp.
And those encamping at the front, eastward, the banner of the camp of Yehudah, by their hosts; and the prince of the children of Yehudah was Nachshon son of Aminadav.
And his host and their counted ones were seventy-four thousand and six hundred.
And those encamping beside him, the tribe of Yissachar; and the prince of the children of Yissachar was Netanel son of Tzuar.
And his host and their counted ones were fifty-four thousand and four hundred.
The tribe of Zevulun; and the prince of the children of Zevulun was Eliav son of Chelon.
And his host and their counted ones were fifty-seven thousand and four hundred.
All the counted ones of the camp of Yehudah were one hundred thousand and eighty thousand and six thousand and four hundred, by their hosts; first they shall journey.
The banner of the camp of Reuven, southward, by their hosts; and the prince of the children of Reuven was Elitzur son of Shede'ur.
And his host and their counted ones were forty-six thousand and five hundred.
And those encamping beside him, the tribe of Shimon; and the prince of the children of Shimon was Shelumiel son of Tzurishadai.
And his host and their counted ones were fifty-nine thousand and three hundred.
And the tribe of Gad; and the prince of the children of Gad was Elyasaf son of Re'uel.
And his host and their counted ones were forty-five thousand six hundred and fifty.
All the counted ones of the camp of Reuven were one hundred thousand and fifty-one thousand and four hundred and fifty, by their hosts; and second they shall journey.
And the Tent of Meeting, the camp of the Leviim, shall journey in the midst of the camps; as they encamp, so they shall journey, a man in his place, by their banners.
The banner of the camp of Efrayim, by their hosts, westward; and the prince of the children of Efrayim was Elishama son of Amihud.
And his host and their counted ones were forty thousand and five hundred.
And beside him, the tribe of Menasheh; and the prince of the children of Menasheh was Gamliel son of Pedatzur.
And his host and their counted ones were thirty-two thousand and two hundred.
And the tribe of Binyamin; and the prince of the children of Binyamin was Avidan son of Gidoni.
And his host and their counted ones were thirty-five thousand and four hundred.
All the counted ones of the camp of Efrayim were one hundred thousand and eight thousand and one hundred, by their hosts; and third they shall journey.
The banner of the camp of Dan, northward, by their hosts; and the prince of the children of Dan was Achiezer son of Amishadai.
And his host and their counted ones were sixty-two thousand and seven hundred.
And those encamping beside him, the tribe of Asher; and the prince of the children of Asher was Pagiel son of Ochran.
And his host and their counted ones were forty-one thousand and five hundred.
The tribe of Naftali; and the prince of the children of Naftali was Achira son of Einan.
And his host and their counted ones were fifty-three thousand and four hundred.
All the counted ones of the camp of Dan were one hundred thousand and fifty-seven thousand and six hundred; last they shall journey, by their banners.

These are the counted ones of the children of Yisroel, by their fathers' house; all the counted ones of the camps, by their hosts, were six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty.
And the Leviim were not counted among the children of Yisroel, as Havayah commanded Moshe.
And the children of Yisroel did according to all that Havayah commanded Moshe, so they encamped by their banners, and so they journeyed, a man by his families, by their fathers' house.
And these are the descendants of Aharon and Moshe, on the day Havayah spoke with Moshe on Mount Sinai.
And these are the names of the sons of Aharon: the firstborn Nadav, and Avihu, Elazar, and Itamar.
These are the names of the sons of Aharon, the anointed priests, whose hand was filled to serve as priests.

And Nadav and Avihu died before Havayah, when they brought near strange fire before Havayah in the wilderness of Sinai, and they had no sons; and Elazar and Itamar served as priests before Aharon their father.
And Havayah spoke to Moshe, saying:
Bring near the tribe of Levi, and stand it before Aharon the priest, and they shall serve him.
And they shall keep his charge, and the charge of all the congregation, before the Tent of Meeting, to perform the service of the Tabernacle.
And they shall keep all the vessels of the Tent of Meeting, and the charge of the children of Yisroel, to perform the service of the Tabernacle.
And you shall give the Leviim to Aharon and to his sons; they are given, given to him from among the children of Yisroel.
And Aharon and his sons you shall appoint, and they shall keep their priesthood; and the stranger who approaches shall be put to death.
And Havayah spoke to Moshe, saying:
And I, behold, I have taken the Leviim from among the children of Yisroel, in place of every firstborn who opens the womb, from the children of Yisroel; and the Leviim shall be Mine.
For every firstborn is Mine; on the day I smote every firstborn in the land of Mitzrayim, I sanctified to Me every firstborn in Yisroel, from man to animal; they shall be Mine; I am Havayah.
And Havayah spoke to Moshe in the wilderness of Sinai, saying:
Count the sons of Levi by their fathers' house, by their families; every male from one month old and above you shall count.
And Moshe counted them according to the word of Havayah, as he was commanded.
And these were the sons of Levi by their names: Gershon, and Kehat, and Merari.
And these are the names of the sons of Gershon by their families: Livni and Shimi.
And the sons of Kehat by their families: Amram, and Yitzhar, Chevron, and Uziel.
And the sons of Merari by their families: Machli and Mushi; these are the families of the Leviim by their fathers' house.
For Gershon, the family of the Livnites and the family of the Shimiites; these are the families of the Gershonites.
Their counted ones, by the number of all males from one month old and above, were seven thousand and five hundred.
The families of the Gershonites shall encamp behind the Tabernacle, westward.
And the prince of the fathers' house of the Gershonites, Elyasaf son of Lael.
And the charge of the sons of Gershon in the Tent of Meeting was: the Tabernacle, and the Tent, its covering, and the screen of the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.
And the hangings of the courtyard, and the screen of the entrance of the courtyard that is by the Tabernacle and by the altar around, and its cords, for all its work.
And for Kehat, the family of the Amramites, and the family of the Yitzharites, and the family of the Chevronites, and the family of the Uzielites; these are the families of the Kehatites.
By the number of all males from one month old and above, they were eight thousand and six hundred, guardians of the holy charge.
The families of the sons of Kehat shall encamp on the side of the Tabernacle, southward.
And the prince of the fathers' house of the families of the Kehatites, Elitzafan son of Uziel.
And their charge: the Ark, and the Table, and the Menorah, and the altars, and the holy vessels with which they serve, and the screen, and all its work.
And the prince of the princes of the Leviim, Elazar son of Aharon the priest, appointed over the guardians of the holy charge.
For Merari, the family of the Machlites and the family of the Mushites; these are the families of Merari.
And their counted ones, by the number of all males from one month old and above, were six thousand and two hundred.
And the prince of the fathers' house of the families of Merari, Tzuriel son of Avichayil; they shall encamp on the side of the Tabernacle, northward.
And the appointed charge of the sons of Merari was: the beams of the Tabernacle, and its bars, and its pillars, and its sockets, and all its vessels, and all its work.
And the pillars of the courtyard around, and their sockets, and their pegs, and their cords.

And those encamping before the Tabernacle, eastward, before the Tent of Meeting, toward the sunrise, Moshe and Aharon and his sons, guardians of the Sanctuary's charge, for the charge of the children of Yisroel; and the stranger who approaches shall be put to death.
All the counted ones of the Leviim, whom Moshe and Aharon counted, by the word of Havayah, by their families, all males from one month old and above, twenty-two thousand.
And Havayah said to Moshe: Count every firstborn male of the children of Yisroel, from one month old and above, and take the number of their names.

And you shall take the Leviim for Me, I am Havayah, in place of every firstborn among the children of Yisroel, and the animals of the Leviim in place of every firstborn among the animals of the children of Yisroel.
And Moshe counted, as Havayah commanded him, all the firstborn among the children of Yisroel.
And all the firstborn males, by the number of names, from one month old and above, by their counted ones, were twenty-two thousand and two hundred and seventy-three.
And Havayah spoke to Moshe, saying:
Take the Leviim in place of all the firstborn among the children of Yisroel, and the animals of the Leviim in place of their animals; and the Leviim shall be Mine; I am Havayah.
And for the redemption of the two hundred and seventy-three firstborn of the children of Yisroel, who are in excess over the Leviim.
You shall take five shekels, five shekels by the head; in the holy shekel you shall take; twenty gera is the shekel.
And you shall give the silver to Aharon and to his sons, the redemption of those who remain among them.
And Moshe took the redemption silver from those who remained over the Leviim.
From the firstborn of the children of Yisroel he took the silver, one thousand three hundred and sixty-five shekels, in the holy shekel.
And Moshe gave the redemption silver to Aharon and to his sons, according to the word of Havayah, as Havayah commanded Moshe.
And Havayah spoke to Moshe and to Aharon, saying:
Take the sum of the sons of Kehat from among the sons of Levi, by their families, by their fathers' house.
From thirty years old and above, and until fifty years old, all who come to the service, to do the work in the Tent of Meeting.
This is the service of the sons of Kehat in the Tent of Meeting: the holy of holies.
And Aharon and his sons shall come when the camp journeys, and they shall take down the screening curtain, and cover with it the Ark of the Testimony.
And they shall place upon it a tachash-hide covering, and spread an entirely sky-blue wool cloth over it from above, and they shall set its staves.

And upon the Table of the Presence they shall spread a sky-blue wool cloth, and place upon it the dishes, and the spoons, and the cups, and the pouring vessels; and the continual bread shall be upon it.
And they shall spread upon them a scarlet-wool cloth, and cover it with a tachash-hide covering, and they shall set its staves.
And they shall take a sky-blue wool cloth, and cover the Menorah of the light, and its lamps, and its tongs, and its fire-pans, and all its oil vessels with which they serve it.
And they shall place it and all its vessels into a tachash-hide covering, and place it upon the pole.
And upon the golden altar they shall spread a sky-blue wool cloth, and cover it with a tachash-hide covering, and they shall set its staves.
And they shall take all the service vessels with which they serve in the Sanctuary, and place them in a sky-blue wool cloth, and cover them with a tachash-hide covering, and place them on the pole.
And they shall remove the ashes from the altar, and spread upon it a purple-wool cloth.

And they shall place upon it all its vessels with which they serve upon it, the fire-pans, the forks, the shovels, and the basins, all the vessels of the altar; and they shall spread upon it a tachash-hide covering, and set its staves.

And Aharon and his sons shall finish covering the holy things, and all the holy vessels, when the camp journeys, and after that the sons of Kehat shall come to bear, and they shall not touch the holy, and they shall die; these are the burden of the sons of Kehat in the Tent of Meeting.

And the charge of Elazar son of Aharon the priest was: the lamp oil, and the fragrant incense, and the daily meal offering, and the anointing oil; the charge of all the Tabernacle, and all that is in it, in the holy, and in its vessels.
And Havayah spoke to Moshe and to Aharon, saying:
Do not cut off the tribe of the families of the Kehatites from among the Leviim.
And this do for them, and they shall live and not die, when they approach the holy of holies; Aharon and his sons shall come, and assign them, each man to his work and to his burden.
And they shall not come to see when the holy things are covered, and they shall die.
And Havayah spoke to Moshe, saying:
Take the sum of the sons of Gershon as well, by their fathers' house, by their families.
From thirty years old and above, until fifty years old, you shall count them, all who come to serve the service, to do work in the Tent of Meeting.
This is the service of the families of the Gershonites, to serve and to bear.
And they shall bear the curtains of the Tabernacle, and the Tent of Meeting, its covering, and the tachash covering that is upon it from above, and the screen of the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.

And the hangings of the courtyard, and the screen of the entrance of the gate of the courtyard, that is by the Tabernacle and by the altar around, and their cords, and all the instruments of their service, and all that is made for them, and they shall serve.
At the word of Aharon and his sons shall be all the service of the sons of the Gershonites, for all their burden and for all their service; and you shall appoint to them as a charge all their burden.
This is the service of the families of the sons of the Gershonites in the Tent of Meeting, and their charge in the hand of Itamar son of Aharon the priest.
The sons of Merari, by their families, by their fathers' house, you shall count them.
From thirty years old and above, until fifty years old, you shall count them, all who come to serve the service, to do the work of the Tent of Meeting.
And this is the charge of their burden, for all their service in the Tent of Meeting: the beams of the Tabernacle, and its bars, and its pillars, and its sockets.

And the pillars of the courtyard around, and their sockets, and their pegs, and their cords, with all their instruments, and for all their service; and by name you shall appoint the instruments of the charge of their burden.
This is the service of the families of the sons of Merari, for all their service in the Tent of Meeting, in the hand of Itamar son of Aharon the priest.
And Moshe and Aharon and the princes of the congregation counted the sons of the Kehatites, by their families and by their fathers' house.
From thirty years old and above, and until fifty years old, all who come to the service, for work in the Tent of Meeting.
And their counted ones, by their families, were two thousand and seven hundred and fifty.
These are the counted ones of the families of the Kehatites, all who serve in the Tent of Meeting, whom Moshe and Aharon counted, by the word of Havayah, by the hand of Moshe.
And the counted ones of the sons of Gershon, by their families and by their fathers' house.
From thirty years old and above, and until fifty years old, all who come to the service, for work in the Tent of Meeting.
And their counted ones, by their families, by their fathers' house, were two thousand and six hundred and thirty.
These are the counted ones of the families of the sons of Gershon, all who serve in the Tent of Meeting, whom Moshe and Aharon counted, by the word of Havayah.
And the counted ones of the families of the sons of Merari, by their families, by their fathers' house.
From thirty years old and above, and until fifty years old, all who come to the service, for work in the Tent of Meeting.
And their counted ones, by their families, were three thousand and two hundred.
These are the counted ones of the families of the sons of Merari, whom Moshe and Aharon counted, by the word of Havayah, by the hand of Moshe.
All the counted ones whom Moshe and Aharon and the princes of Yisroel counted, the Leviim, by their families and by their fathers' house.
From thirty years old and above, and until fifty years old, all who come to do the labor service and the carrying service in the Tent of Meeting.
And their counted ones were eight thousand and five hundred and eighty.
By the word of Havayah he counted them, by the hand of Moshe, each man to his service and to his burden; and they were counted as Havayah commanded Moshe.
And Havayah spoke to Moshe, saying:
Command the children of Yisroel, and they shall send out from the camp every leper, and every one with a discharge, and everyone impure by a corpse.
Male and female you shall send out, outside the camp you shall send them, and they shall not defile their camp, in which I dwell in their midst.
And the children of Yisroel did so, and sent them outside the camp; as Havayah spoke to Moshe, so the children of Yisroel did.
And Havayah spoke to Moshe, saying:
Speak to the children of Yisroel: a man or a woman, when they commit any of the sins of man, to commit a trespass against Havayah, and that person is guilty.
And they shall confess their sin that they committed, and he shall return his guilt in its principal, and add its fifth to it, and give it to the one against whom he is guilty.
And if the man has no redeemer to return the guilt to him, the guilt returned to Havayah is the priest's, besides the atonement ram with which he shall atone for him.
And every gift of all the sacred things of the children of Yisroel, that they bring to the priest, shall be his.
And a man's sacred things shall be his; what a man gives to the priest shall be his.
And Havayah spoke to Moshe, saying:
Speak to the children of Yisroel, and say to them: a man whose wife shall go astray and commit a trespass against him.
And a man lay with her, a lying of seed, and it was hidden from the eyes of her husband, and she was secluded, and she was defiled, and there is no witness against her, and she was not seized.
And a spirit of jealousy came upon him, and he was jealous of his wife, and she was defiled; or a spirit of jealousy came upon him, and he was jealous of his wife, and she was not defiled.

And the man shall bring his wife to the priest, and bring her offering for her, a tenth of an ephah of barley flour; he shall not pour oil upon it, and he shall not place frankincense upon it, for it is a jealousy meal offering, a remembrance meal offering, recalling iniquity.
And the priest shall bring her near, and stand her before Havayah.
And the priest shall take sacred water in an earthenware vessel, and from the dust that is on the floor of the Tabernacle the priest shall take, and place it into the water.

And the priest shall stand the woman before Havayah, and uncover the head of the woman, and place upon her palms the remembrance meal offering, it is the jealousy meal offering; and in the hand of the priest shall be the bitter cursing water.
And the priest shall make her swear, and say to the woman: If no man has lain with you, and if you have not gone astray to defilement under your husband, be absolved from the bitter cursing water.
And you, if you have gone astray under your husband, and if you were defiled, and a man gave his lying with you, besides your husband.

And the priest shall make her swear with the oath of the curse, and the priest shall say to the woman: May Havayah make you a curse and an oath among your people, when Havayah makes your thigh fall, and your belly swell.
And this cursing water shall come into your inward parts, to make the belly swell and to make the thigh fall; and the woman shall say: Amen, amen.
And the priest shall write these curses in a scroll, and wash them into the bitter water.
And he shall give the woman the bitter water to drink, the cursed, and the cursing water shall enter into her for bitterness.
And the priest shall take the meal offering of jealousy from the hand of the woman, and wave the meal offering before Havayah, and bring it near to the altar.
And the priest shall take a handful from the meal offering, its memorial, and burn it upon the altar, and afterwards he shall give the woman the water to drink.

And he shall give her the water to drink, and it shall be, if she was defiled and committed a trespass against her husband, and the cursing waters shall enter into her for bitterness, and her belly shall swell and her thigh shall fall, and the woman shall become a curse among her people.
And if the woman was not defiled, and she is pure, then she shall be absolved, and she shall conceive seed.
This is the jealousy law, when a woman shall go astray under her husband, and she was defiled.
Or a man over whom a spirit of jealousy shall come, and he was jealous of his wife, and he shall stand the woman before Havayah, and the priest shall do to her all this law.
And the man shall be clear from iniquity, and that woman shall bear her iniquity.
And Havayah spoke to Moshe, saying:
Speak to the children of Yisroel, and say to them: a man or a woman, when he shall vow a vow of a nazirite, to abstain for Havayah.

From wine and intoxicating drink he shall abstain; he shall not drink wine vinegar and intoxicating-drink vinegar, and he shall not drink any soaking of grapes, and he shall not eat grapes fresh or dried.
All the days of his naziriteship, from all that is made of the grapevine, from pits to skin, he shall not eat.
All the days of his vow of naziriteship, a razor shall not pass over his head; until the completion of the days that he abstains for Havayah, he shall be holy, growing long the hair of his head.
All the days that he abstains for Havayah, he shall not come to a dead soul.
For his father and for his mother, for his brother and for his sister, he shall not become impure for them in their death, for the crown of his Elokim is upon his head.
All the days of his naziriteship, he is holy to Havayah.
And if one dies beside him suddenly, suddenly, and he defiles the head of his naziriteship, and he shall shave his head on the day of his purification; on the seventh day he shall shave it.
And on the eighth day he shall bring two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, to the priest, to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.
And the priest shall prepare one for a sin offering, and one for a burnt offering, and atone for him for that which he sinned by the soul; and he shall sanctify his head on that day.
And he shall dedicate to Havayah the days of his naziriteship, and bring a lamb in its first year for a guilt offering; and the first days shall fall, for his naziriteship was defiled.
And this is the law of the nazirite, on the day of the completion of the days of his naziriteship: he shall bring him to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.

And he shall bring near his offering to Havayah, one lamb in its first year, unblemished, for a burnt offering, and one ewe in its first year, unblemished, for a sin offering, and one ram, unblemished, for a peace offering.
And a basket of unleavened bread, fine-flour loaves mixed with oil, and wafers of unleavened bread spread with oil, and their meal offering and their libations.
And the priest shall bring him near before Havayah, and perform his sin offering and his burnt offering.
And the ram he shall make a peace offering to Havayah, with the basket of unleavened bread; and the priest shall perform its meal offering and its libation.

And the nazirite shall shave the head of his naziriteship at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting, and take the hair of the head of his naziriteship, and place it upon the fire that is under the peace offering.

And the priest shall take the cooked foreleg from the ram, and one loaf of unleavened bread from the basket, and one wafer of unleavened bread, and place them upon the palms of the nazirite, after he has shaved his naziriteship.
And the priest shall wave them, a wave offering before Havayah; it is holy for the priest, upon the waved breast and upon the lifted thigh; and afterwards the nazirite may drink wine.

This is the law of the nazirite who vows his offering to Havayah for his naziriteship, besides that which his hand attains; according to his vow that he vows, so he shall do, upon the law of his naziriteship.
And Havayah spoke to Moshe, saying:
Speak to Aharon and to his sons, saying: so shall you bless the children of Yisroel, saying to them:
May Havayah bless you, and keep you.
May Havayah shine His face upon you, and be gracious to you.
May Havayah lift His face toward you, and grant you peace.
And they shall place My name upon the children of Yisroel, and I shall bless them.
And it was on the day Moshe finished erecting the Tabernacle, and he anointed it and sanctified it, and all its vessels, and the altar and all its vessels, and he anointed them and sanctified them.
And the princes of Yisroel brought near, heads of their fathers' house, they are the princes of the tribes, they are the ones who stand over the counted ones.
And they brought their offering before Havayah: six covered wagons and twelve oxen, a wagon for two princes, and an ox for each one; and they brought them before the Tabernacle.
And Havayah spoke to Moshe, saying:
Take from them, and they shall be for the service of the Tent of Meeting, and you shall give them to the Leviim, a man according to his service.
And Moshe took the wagons and the oxen, and gave them to the Leviim.
He gave two wagons and four oxen to the sons of Gershon, according to their service.
He gave four wagons and eight oxen to the sons of Merari, according to their service, in the hand of Itamar son of Aharon the priest.
And to the sons of Kehat he did not give, for the holy service is upon them; on the shoulder they shall bear.
And the princes brought near the dedication of the altar on the day it was anointed, and the princes brought their offering before the altar.
And Havayah said to Moshe: one prince a day, one prince a day shall bring near their offering for the dedication of the altar.
The one who brought near his offering on the first day was Nachshon son of Aminadav, for the tribe of Yehudah.
His offering: one silver dish weighing one hundred and thirty shekels; one silver basin of seventy shekels, in the holy shekel; both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil, a meal offering.
One ladle of ten shekels of gold, full of incense.
One young bull, one ram, one lamb in its first year, for a burnt offering.
One goat, a male, for a sin offering.
And for the peace offering: two cattle, five rams, five male goats, five lambs in their first year. This is the offering of Nachshon son of Aminadav.
On the second day, Netanel son of Tzuar, prince of Yissachar, brought near.
His offering: one silver dish weighing one hundred and thirty shekels; one silver basin of seventy shekels, in the holy shekel; both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil, a meal offering.
One ladle of ten shekels of gold, full of incense.
One young bull, one ram, one lamb in its first year, for a burnt offering.
One goat, a male, for a sin offering.
And for the peace offering: two cattle, five rams, five male goats, five lambs in their first year. This is the offering of Netanel son of Tzuar.
On the third day, the prince of the children of Zevulun, Eliav son of Chelon, brought near.
His offering: one silver dish weighing one hundred and thirty shekels; one silver basin of seventy shekels, in the holy shekel; both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil, a meal offering.
One ladle of ten shekels of gold, full of incense.
One young bull, one ram, one lamb in its first year, for a burnt offering.
One goat, a male, for a sin offering.
And for the peace offering: two cattle, five rams, five male goats, five lambs in their first year. This is the offering of Eliav son of Chelon.
On the fourth day, the prince of the children of Reuven, Elitzur son of Shede'ur, brought near.
His offering: one silver dish weighing one hundred and thirty shekels; one silver basin of seventy shekels, in the holy shekel; both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil, a meal offering.
One ladle of ten shekels of gold, full of incense.
One young bull, one ram, one lamb in its first year, for a burnt offering.
One goat, a male, for a sin offering.
And for the peace offering: two cattle, five rams, five male goats, five lambs in their first year. This is the offering of Elitzur son of Shede'ur.
On the fifth day, the prince of the children of Shimon, Shelumiel son of Tzurishadai, brought near.
His offering: one silver dish weighing one hundred and thirty shekels; one silver basin of seventy shekels, in the holy shekel; both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil, a meal offering.
One ladle of ten shekels of gold, full of incense.
One young bull, one ram, one lamb in its first year, for a burnt offering.
One goat, a male, for a sin offering.
And for the peace offering: two cattle, five rams, five male goats, five lambs in their first year. This is the offering of Shelumiel son of Tzurishadai.
On the sixth day, the prince of the children of Gad, Elyasaf son of De'uel, brought near.
His offering: one silver dish weighing one hundred and thirty shekels; one silver basin of seventy shekels, in the holy shekel; both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil, a meal offering.
One ladle of ten shekels of gold, full of incense.
One young bull, one ram, one lamb in its first year, for a burnt offering.
One goat, a male, for a sin offering.
And for the peace offering: two cattle, five rams, five male goats, five lambs in their first year. This is the offering of Elyasaf son of De'uel.
On the seventh day, the prince of the children of Efrayim, Elishama son of Amihud, brought near.
His offering: one silver dish weighing one hundred and thirty shekels; one silver basin of seventy shekels, in the holy shekel; both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil, a meal offering.
One ladle of ten shekels of gold, full of incense.
One young bull, one ram, one lamb in its first year, for a burnt offering.
One goat, a male, for a sin offering.
And for the peace offering: two cattle, five rams, five male goats, five lambs in their first year. This is the offering of Elishama son of Amihud.
On the eighth day, the prince of the children of Menasheh, Gamliel son of Pedatzur, brought near.
His offering: one silver dish weighing one hundred and thirty shekels; one silver basin of seventy shekels, in the holy shekel; both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil, a meal offering.
One ladle of ten shekels of gold, full of incense.
One young bull, one ram, one lamb in its first year, for a burnt offering.
One goat, a male, for a sin offering.
And for the peace offering: two cattle, five rams, five male goats, five lambs in their first year. This is the offering of Gamliel son of Pedatzur.
On the ninth day, the prince of the children of Binyamin, Avidan son of Gidoni, brought near.
His offering: one silver dish weighing one hundred and thirty shekels; one silver basin of seventy shekels, in the holy shekel; both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil, a meal offering.
One ladle of ten shekels of gold, full of incense.
One young bull, one ram, one lamb in its first year, for a burnt offering.
One goat, a male, for a sin offering.
And for the peace offering: two cattle, five rams, five male goats, five lambs in their first year. This is the offering of Avidan son of Gidoni.
On the tenth day, the prince of the children of Dan, Achiezer son of Amishadai, brought near.
His offering: one silver dish weighing one hundred and thirty shekels; one silver basin of seventy shekels, in the holy shekel; both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil, a meal offering.
One ladle of ten shekels of gold, full of incense.
One young bull, one ram, one lamb in its first year, for a burnt offering.
One goat, a male, for a sin offering.
And for the peace offering: two cattle, five rams, five male goats, five lambs in their first year. This is the offering of Achiezer son of Amishadai.
On the eleventh day, the prince of the children of Asher, Pagiel son of Ochran, brought near.
His offering: one silver dish weighing one hundred and thirty shekels; one silver basin of seventy shekels, in the holy shekel; both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil, a meal offering.
One ladle of ten shekels of gold, full of incense.
One young bull, one ram, one lamb in its first year, for a burnt offering.
One goat, a male, for a sin offering.
And for the peace offering: two cattle, five rams, five male goats, five lambs in their first year. This is the offering of Pagiel son of Ochran.
On the twelfth day, the prince of the children of Naftali, Achira son of Einan, brought near.
His offering: one silver dish weighing one hundred and thirty shekels; one silver basin of seventy shekels, in the holy shekel; both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil, a meal offering.
One ladle of ten shekels of gold, full of incense.
One young bull, one ram, one lamb in its first year, for a burnt offering.
One goat, a male, for a sin offering.
And for the peace offering: two cattle, five rams, five male goats, five lambs in their first year. This is the offering of Achira son of Einan.
This is the dedication of the altar, on the day it was anointed, from the princes of Yisroel: twelve silver dishes, twelve silver basins, twelve golden ladles.
One hundred and thirty shekels of silver a dish, and seventy a basin; all the silver of the vessels, two thousand and four hundred, in the holy shekel.
Twelve golden ladles, full of incense; ten shekels a ladle, in the holy shekel; all the gold of the ladles, one hundred and twenty.
All the cattle for the burnt offering: twelve bulls, twelve rams, twelve lambs in their first year, and their meal offering; and twelve male goats for a sin offering.
And all the cattle for the peace offering: twenty-four bulls, sixty rams, sixty male goats, sixty lambs in their first year. This is the dedication of the altar, after it was anointed.

And when Moshe came into the Tent of Meeting to speak with Him, he heard the voice speaking to him from above the covering that was upon the Ark of the Testimony, from between the two cherubs; and He spoke to him.
And Havayah spoke to Moshe, saying:
Speak to Aharon, and say to him: When you kindle the lamps, the seven lamps shall give light toward the face of the Menorah.
And Aharon did so; toward the face of the Menorah he kindled its lamps, as Havayah commanded Moshe.
And this is the work of the Menorah, hammered gold, from its base to its flower, it is hammered work; as the vision that Havayah showed Moshe, so he made the Menorah.
And Havayah spoke to Moshe, saying:
Take the Leviim from among the children of Yisroel, and purify them.
And so shall you do to them, to purify them: sprinkle purification water upon them, and they shall pass a razor over all their flesh, and wash their clothes, and purify themselves.
And they shall take a young bull, and its meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil; and a second young bull you shall take for a sin offering.
And you shall bring near the Leviim before the Tent of Meeting, and assemble all the congregation of the children of Yisroel.
And you shall bring near the Leviim before Havayah, and the children of Yisroel shall lay their hands upon the Leviim.
And Aharon shall wave the Leviim, a wave offering before Havayah, from the children of Yisroel, and they shall be to perform the service of Havayah.
And the Leviim shall lay their hands upon the head of the bulls, and make one a sin offering, and one a burnt offering to Havayah, to atone for the Leviim.
And you shall stand the Leviim before Aharon and before his sons, and wave them, a wave offering to Havayah.
And you shall separate the Leviim from among the children of Yisroel, and the Leviim shall be Mine.
And afterwards the Leviim shall come to serve the Tent of Meeting, and you shall purify them, and wave them, a wave offering.
For they are given, given to Me from among the children of Yisroel; in place of every firstborn who opens the womb, of all the children of Yisroel, I have taken them for Myself.
For every firstborn among the children of Yisroel is Mine, in man and in animal; on the day I smote every firstborn in the land of Mitzrayim, I sanctified them for Myself.
And I have taken the Leviim in place of every firstborn among the children of Yisroel.

And I have given the Leviim, given to Aharon and to his sons from among the children of Yisroel, to perform the service of the children of Yisroel in the Tent of Meeting, and to atone for the children of Yisroel, and there shall not be a plague among the children of Yisroel, when the children of Yisroel approach the Sanctuary.
And Moshe and Aharon and all the congregation of the children of Yisroel did to the Leviim according to all that Havayah commanded Moshe concerning the Leviim, so the children of Yisroel did to them.
And the Leviim purified themselves, and washed their clothes, and Aharon waved them, a wave offering before Havayah, and Aharon atoned for them, to purify them.
And afterwards the Leviim came to perform their service in the Tent of Meeting, before Aharon and before his sons; as Havayah commanded Moshe concerning the Leviim, so they did to them.
And Havayah spoke to Moshe, saying:
This is that which is for the Leviim: from twenty-five years old and above, he shall come to serve the service in the Tent of Meeting.
And from fifty years old, he shall return from the service of the work, and he shall serve no more.
And he shall serve with his brethren in the Tent of Meeting, to keep the charge, and he shall do no work; so shall you do to the Leviim in their charges.
And Havayah spoke to Moshe in the wilderness of Sinai, in the second year of their going out from the land of Mitzrayim, in the first month, saying:
And the children of Yisroel shall make the Pesach at its appointed time.
On the fourteenth day of this month, between the evenings, you shall make it at its appointed time; according to all its statutes and according to all its ordinances you shall make it.
And Moshe spoke to the children of Yisroel, to make the Pesach.

And they made the Pesach in the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, between the evenings, in the wilderness of Sinai; according to all that Havayah commanded Moshe, so the children of Yisroel did.
And there were men who were impure by a dead soul, and they could not make the Pesach on that day; and they approached before Moshe and before Aharon on that day.
And those men said to him: We are impure by a dead soul; why shall we be deprived of bringing near the offering of Havayah at its appointed time, among the children of Yisroel?
And Moshe said to them: Stand, and I will hear what Havayah will command for you.
And Havayah spoke to Moshe, saying:
Speak to the children of Yisroel, saying: a man who shall be impure by a dead soul, or on a distant way, for you or for your generations, and he shall make a Pesach to Havayah.
In the second month, on the fourteenth day, between the evenings, they shall make it; with unleavened bread and bitter herbs they shall eat it.
They shall not leave of it until morning, and they shall not break a bone in it; according to all the statute of the Pesach they shall make it.

And the man who is pure, and was not on a way, and refrained from making the Pesach, and that soul shall be cut off from its people, for he did not bring near the offering of Havayah at its appointed time; that man shall bear his sin.

And when a stranger shall dwell with you, and make a Pesach to Havayah, according to the statute of the Pesach and according to its ordinance, so he shall make; one statute shall be for you, for the stranger and for the native of the land.
And on the day the Tabernacle was erected, the cloud covered the Tabernacle, the Tent of the Testimony; and in the evening there would be upon the Tabernacle as the appearance of fire, until morning.
So it would be always: the cloud would cover it, and the appearance of fire at night.
And according to the rising of the cloud from upon the Tent, afterwards the children of Yisroel would journey; and in the place where the cloud would rest, there the children of Yisroel would encamp.
By the word of Havayah the children of Yisroel would journey, and by the word of Havayah they would encamp; all the days that the cloud rests upon the Tabernacle, they encamp.
And when the cloud lingered upon the Tabernacle many days, the children of Yisroel kept the charge of Havayah, and did not journey.
And at times the cloud would be a number of days upon the Tabernacle; by the word of Havayah they would encamp, and by the word of Havayah they would journey.
And at times the cloud would be from evening until morning, and the cloud would rise in the morning, and they would journey; or a day and a night, and the cloud would rise, and they would journey.
Or two days, or a month, or days, when the cloud lingered upon the Tabernacle, resting upon it, the children of Yisroel would encamp, they would not journey; and when it rose, they would journey.
By the word of Havayah they would encamp, and by the word of Havayah they would journey; they kept the charge of Havayah, by the word of Havayah, by the hand of Moshe.
And Havayah spoke to Moshe, saying:
Make for yourself two silver trumpets; you shall make them of hammered work, and they shall be for you for the summoning of the congregation, and for the journeying of the camps.
And they shall sound with them, and all the congregation shall assemble to you, to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.
And if they shall sound with one, and the princes, heads of the thousands of Yisroel, shall assemble to you.
And you shall sound an alarm, and the camps that encamp eastward shall journey.
And you shall sound an alarm a second time, and the camps that encamp southward shall journey; an alarm they shall sound for their journeys.
And when you assemble the congregation, you shall sound, and you shall not sound an alarm.
And the sons of Aharon, the priests, shall sound the trumpets; and they shall be for you for an eternal statute, for your generations.

And when you come to war in your land against the adversary who oppresses you, and you shall sound an alarm with the trumpets, and you shall be remembered before Havayah your Elokim, and you shall be saved from your enemies.

And on the day of your rejoicing, and on your appointed times, and on the beginnings of your months, you shall sound the trumpets over your burnt offerings and over your peace offerings; and they shall be for you for a remembrance before your Elokim; I am Havayah your Elokim.
And it was in the second year, in the second month, on the twentieth of the month, the cloud rose up from upon the Tabernacle of the Testimony.
And the children of Yisroel journeyed on their journeys from the wilderness of Sinai, and the cloud rested in the wilderness of Paran.
And they journeyed at the first, by the word of Havayah, by the hand of Moshe.
And the banner of the camp of the sons of Yehudah journeyed at the first, by their hosts; and over its host was Nachshon son of Aminadav.
And over the host of the tribe of the children of Yissachar was Netanel son of Tzuar.
And over the host of the tribe of the children of Zevulun was Eliav son of Chelon.
And the Tabernacle was taken down, and the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari journeyed, bearers of the Tabernacle.
And the banner of the camp of Reuven journeyed, by their hosts; and over its host was Elitzur son of Shede'ur.
And over the host of the tribe of the children of Shimon was Shelumiel son of Tzurishadai.
And over the host of the tribe of the children of Gad was Elyasaf son of De'uel.
And the Kehatites journeyed, bearers of the Sanctuary; and they erected the Tabernacle before their coming.
And the banner of the camp of the children of Efrayim journeyed, by their hosts; and over its host was Elishama son of Amihud.
And over the host of the tribe of the children of Menasheh was Gamliel son of Pedatzur.
And over the host of the tribe of the children of Binyamin was Avidan son of Gidoni.
And the banner of the camp of the children of Dan journeyed, the rearguard of all the camps, by their hosts; and over its host was Achiezer son of Amishadai.
And over the host of the tribe of the children of Asher was Pagiel son of Ochran.
And over the host of the tribe of the children of Naftali was Achira son of Einan.
These are the journeys of the children of Yisroel, by their hosts; and they journeyed.

And Moshe said to Chovav son of Re'uel the Midyani, father-in-law of Moshe: We are journeying to the place that Havayah said, I will give it to you; go with us, and we will do good to you, for Havayah has spoken good concerning Yisroel.
And he said to him: I will not go; for I will go to my land and to my birthplace.
And he said: Please do not leave us, for you know our encamping in the wilderness, and you shall be eyes for us.
And it shall be, if you go with us, the good that Havayah shall do to us, we will do good to you.
And they journeyed from the mountain of Havayah a journey of three days, and the Ark of the Covenant of Havayah journeyed before them a journey of three days, to seek out for them a resting place.
And the cloud of Havayah was upon them by day, when they journeyed from the camp.
And it was, when the Ark journeyed, and Moshe said: Arise, Havayah, and let Your enemies be scattered, and let those who hate You flee from before You.
And when it rested, he said: Return, Havayah, to the myriads of the thousands of Yisroel.
And the people were as complainers, evil in the ears of Havayah; and Havayah heard, and His anger burned, and the fire of Havayah burned in them, and consumed the edge of the camp.
And the people cried to Moshe, and Moshe prayed to Havayah, and the fire sank.
And he called that place Tav'erah, for the fire of Havayah burned in them.
And the mixed multitude that was in their midst craved a craving; and the children of Yisroel also returned and wept, and said: Who will feed us meat?
We remember the fish that we ate in Mitzrayim for free, the cucumbers, and the melons, and the leeks, and the onions, and the garlic.
And now our soul is dried up; there is nothing at all, except for this manna before our eyes.
And the manna was as coriander seed, and its appearance as the appearance of bdellium.
The people roamed and gathered, and ground in a mill, or crushed in a mortar, and boiled in a pot, and made it into cakes; and its taste was like the taste of an oil cake.
And when the dew descended upon the camp at night, the manna would descend upon it.
And Moshe heard the people weeping, by their families, a man at the entrance of his tent; and the anger of Havayah burned greatly, and in the eyes of Moshe it was evil.
And Moshe said to Havayah: Why have You done evil to Your servant, and why have I not found favor in Your eyes, to place the burden of all this people upon me?
Did I conceive all this people? Did I give birth to it, that You should say to me: Carry it in your bosom, as a nurse carries the suckling, to the land that You swore to its forefathers?
From where do I have meat to give to all this people, for they cry to me, saying: Give us meat, and we shall eat?
I cannot, I alone, bear all this people, for it is too heavy for me.
And if so You do to me, please kill me, if I have found favor in Your eyes, and let me not see my evil.

And Havayah said to Moshe: Gather to Me seventy men of the elders of Yisroel, whom you know that they are elders of the people and its officers, and take them to the Tent of Meeting, and they shall stand there with you.
And I will descend and speak with you there, and draw from the spirit that is upon you, and place upon them; and they shall bear with you the burden of the people, and you shall not bear alone.

And to the people you shall say: Prepare yourselves for tomorrow, and you shall eat meat, for you have wept in the ears of Havayah, saying: Who will feed us meat, for it was good for us in Mitzrayim; and Havayah will give you meat, and you shall eat.
You shall not eat one day, and not two days, and not five days, and not ten days, and not twenty days.

Until a whole month, until it comes out of your nose, and it shall be to you for loathing, because you despised Havayah who is in your midst, and you wept before Him, saying: Why did we come out of Mitzrayim?
And Moshe said: Six hundred thousand footmen are the people in whose midst I am, and You said: I will give them meat, and they shall eat for a whole month.
Shall flocks and cattle be slaughtered for them, and will it suffice for them? If all the fish of the sea shall be gathered for them, will it suffice for them?
And Havayah said to Moshe: Is the hand of Havayah too short? Now you shall see whether My word happens to you or not.
And Moshe went out, and spoke the words of Havayah to the people, and gathered seventy men of the elders of the people, and stood them around the Tent.

And Havayah descended in the cloud, and spoke to him, and drew from the spirit that was upon him, and gave upon the seventy men, the elders; and it was, when the spirit rested upon them, they prophesied, and they did not continue.

And two men remained in the camp, the name of one Eldad, and the name of the second Meidad, and the spirit rested upon them, and they were among the written ones, and they did not go out to the Tent, and they prophesied in the camp.
And the young man ran, and told Moshe, and said: Eldad and Meidad are prophesying in the camp.
And Yehoshua son of Nun, servant of Moshe from his youth, answered, and said: My master Moshe, restrain them.
And Moshe said to him: Are you jealous for me? Would that all the people of Havayah were prophets, that Havayah would place His spirit upon them.
And Moshe returned to the camp, he and the elders of Yisroel.

And a wind went out from Havayah, and cut off quails from the sea, and left them over the camp, about a day's journey here, and about a day's journey there, around the camp, and about two cubits above the face of the earth.
And the people rose all that day, and all the night, and all the next day, and gathered the quail; he who gathered least gathered ten heaps, and they spread them for themselves around the camp.
The meat was still between their teeth, before it was cut off, and the anger of Havayah burned against the people, and Havayah struck the people with a very great blow.
And he called that place Kivros HaTa'avah, for there they buried the people who craved.
From Kivros HaTa'avah the people journeyed to Chatzeros, and they were in Chatzeros.
And Miriam and Aharon spoke against Moshe, concerning the Kushi woman whom he had taken, for a Kushi woman he had taken.
And they said: Is it only with Moshe that Havayah spoke? Did He not speak with us as well? And Havayah heard.
And the man Moshe was very humble, more than any man who is on the face of the earth.
And Havayah said suddenly to Moshe, and to Aharon, and to Miriam: Go out, the three of you, to the Tent of Meeting; and the three of them went out.
And Havayah descended in a cloud pillar, and stood at the entrance of the Tent, and called Aharon and Miriam, and the two of them went out.
And He said: Hear now My words: if there is a prophet among you, Havayah, in a vision I make Myself known to him, in a dream I speak with him.
Not so My servant Moshe; in all My house he is trusted.
Mouth to mouth I speak with him, in a clear vision, and not in riddles; and the image of Havayah he beholds; and why did you not fear to speak against My servant, against Moshe?
And the anger of Havayah burned against them, and He went.
And the cloud departed from upon the Tent, and behold, Miriam was leprous as snow; and Aharon turned to Miriam, and behold, she was leprous.
And Aharon said to Moshe: Please, my master, do not place upon us sin, for we have acted foolishly, and we have sinned.
Please, let her not be as the dead, who, when he comes out of his mother's womb, half his flesh is consumed.
And Moshe cried to Havayah, saying: El, please, heal her now.
And Havayah said to Moshe: If her father had spat in her face, would she not be ashamed seven days? She shall be shut outside the camp seven days, and afterwards she shall be gathered in.
And Miriam was shut outside the camp seven days, and the people did not journey until Miriam was gathered in.
And afterwards the people journeyed from Chatzeros, and encamped in the wilderness of Paran.
And Havayah spoke to Moshe, saying:
Send for yourself men, and they shall scout the land of Kena'an, that I am giving to the children of Yisroel; one man for each tribe of his fathers you shall send, every one a prince among them.
And Moshe sent them from the wilderness of Paran, by the word of Havayah; all of them men, heads of the children of Yisroel.
And these are their names: for the tribe of Reuven, Shamua son of Zakkur.
For the tribe of Shimon, Shafat son of Chori.
For the tribe of Yehudah, Kalev son of Yefuneh.
For the tribe of Yissachar, Yigal son of Yosef.
For the tribe of Efrayim, Hoshea son of Nun.
For the tribe of Binyamin, Palti son of Rafu.
For the tribe of Zevulun, Gadiel son of Sodi.
For the tribe of Yosef, for the tribe of Menasheh, Gadi son of Susi.
For the tribe of Dan, Amiel son of Gemali.
For the tribe of Asher, Setur son of Mikhael.
For the tribe of Naftali, Nachbi son of Vofsi.
For the tribe of Gad, Geuel son of Machi.
These are the names of the men whom Moshe sent to scout the land; and Moshe called Hoshea son of Nun, Yehoshua.
And Moshe sent them to scout the land of Kena'an, and said to them: Go up this way, by the south, and go up the mountain.
And you shall see the land, what it is, and the people who dwell in it, are they strong or weak, few or many?
And what is the land in which they dwell, is it good or bad; and what are the cities in which they dwell, in camps or in fortresses?
And what is the land, is it fat or lean; is there a tree in it or not; and you shall strengthen yourselves, and take of the fruit of the land; and the days were the days of the first ripe grapes.
And they went up, and scouted the land, from the wilderness of Tzin until Rechov, to Levo Chamas.
And they went up in the south, and they came until Chevron, and there were Achiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, children of the giant; and Chevron was built seven years before Tzoan of Mitzrayim.
And they came until the valley of Eshkol, and cut from there a vine and one cluster of grapes, and carried it on a pole by two, and they took of the pomegranates and of the figs.
That place he called the Valley of Eshkol, because of the cluster that the children of Yisroel cut from there.
And they returned from scouting the land, at the end of forty days.

And they went, and came to Moshe and to Aharon and to all the congregation of the children of Yisroel, to the wilderness of Paran, to Kadesh, and brought back word to them and to all the congregation, and showed them the fruit of the land.
And they told him, and said: We came to the land to which you sent us, and indeed it flows with milk and honey, and this is its fruit.
Only, the people who dwell in the land are strong, and the cities are fortified, very great; and also the children of the giant we saw there.
Amalek dwells in the land of the south, and the Chitti, and the Yevusi, and the Emori dwell in the mountain, and the Kena'ani dwells by the sea and along the Yarden.
And Kalev silenced the people toward Moshe, and said: We shall surely go up and possess it, for we are able to overcome it.
And the men who went up with him said: We cannot go up to the people, for it is stronger than we.

And they brought out an evil report of the land that they scouted, to the children of Yisroel, saying: The land that we passed through to scout it, it is a land that devours its inhabitants, and all the people that we saw in it are men of stature.
And there we saw the Nefilim, sons of Anak, from the Nefilim; and we were in our eyes as grasshoppers, and so we were in their eyes.
And all the congregation lifted up, and gave their voice, and the people wept on that night.

And all the children of Yisroel murmured against Moshe and against Aharon, and all the congregation said to them: If only we had died in the land of Mitzrayim, or in this wilderness, if only we had died.
And why does Havayah bring us to this land, to fall by the sword? Our wives and our little ones shall be for spoil; is it not better for us to return to Mitzrayim?
And they said, a man to his brother: Let us appoint a head, and return to Mitzrayim.
And Moshe and Aharon fell upon their faces, before all the assembly of the congregation of the children of Yisroel.
And Yehoshua son of Nun, and Kalev son of Yefuneh, of those who scouted the land, tore their garments.
And they said to all the congregation of the children of Yisroel, saying: The land that we passed through to scout it is very, very good.
If Havayah is pleased with us, He will bring us to this land, and give it to us, a land flowing with milk and honey.
Only, do not rebel against Havayah, and you, do not fear the people of the land, for they are our bread; their protection has departed from them, and Havayah is with us; do not fear them.
And all the congregation said to stone them with stones; and the glory of Havayah appeared in the Tent of Meeting, to all the children of Yisroel.
And Havayah said to Moshe: Until when will this people scorn Me, and until when will they not believe in Me, with all the signs that I have done in their midst?
I will strike them with pestilence, and destroy them, and make you into a nation greater and mightier than they.
And Moshe said to Havayah: And Mitzrayim will hear, for You brought up this people with Your might from its midst.

And they will say to the inhabitants of this land, who have heard that You, Havayah, are in the midst of this people, that eye to eye You are seen, You, Havayah, and Your cloud stands over them, and in a cloud pillar You go before them by day, and in a fire pillar by night.
And if You kill this people as one man, the nations that have heard Your fame will say, saying:
Because Havayah was unable to bring this people to the land that He swore to them, He slaughtered them in the wilderness.
And now, please, let the might of my Master be great, as You spoke, saying:

Havayah, slow to anger and abounding in kindness, bearing iniquity and transgression, and He will not acquit the guilty, visiting the iniquity of fathers upon children, upon the third and upon the fourth.
Please pardon the iniquity of this people, according to the greatness of Your kindness, and as You have borne this people, from Mitzrayim until now.
And Havayah said: I have pardoned, according to your word.
But as I live, all the earth shall be filled with the glory of Havayah.
For all the men who saw My glory and My signs, that I did in Mitzrayim and in the wilderness, and tested Me these ten times, and did not listen to My voice.
They shall not see the land that I swore to their fathers, and all who scorn Me shall not see it.
And My servant Kalev, because another spirit was with him, and he followed Me fully, I will bring him to the land to which he came, and his descendants shall possess it.
And the Amaleki and the Kena'ani dwell in the valley; tomorrow, turn and journey for yourselves to the wilderness, by the way of the Yam Suf.
And Havayah spoke to Moshe and to Aharon, saying:
How long shall this evil congregation murmur against Me? The murmurings of the children of Yisroel, that they murmur against Me, I have heard.
Say to them: As I live, utterance of Havayah, as you spoke in My ears, so I shall do to you.
In this wilderness your carcasses shall fall, and all your counted ones, in all your countings, from twenty years old and above, who murmured against Me.
You shall not come to the land, that I raised My hand to settle you in it, except for Kalev son of Yefuneh and Yehoshua son of Nun.
And your little ones, of whom you said they shall be for spoil, I will bring them, and they shall know the land that you despised.
And as for you, your carcasses shall fall in this wilderness.
And your children shall be wanderers in the wilderness forty years, and bear your strayings, until your carcasses are finished in the wilderness.
By the number of the days that you scouted the land, forty days, a day for a year, a day for a year, you shall bear your iniquities, forty years, and you shall know My estrangement.
I, Havayah, have spoken; this I shall do to all this evil congregation, who gathered against Me; in this wilderness they shall be finished, and there they shall die.
And the men whom Moshe sent to scout the land, and returned, and made all the congregation murmur against him, to bring out an evil report of the land.
And the men, spreaders of the evil report of the land, died in a plague before Havayah.
And Yehoshua son of Nun, and Kalev son of Yefuneh, lived, of those men who went to scout the land.
And Moshe spoke these words to all the children of Yisroel, and the people mourned greatly.
And they rose early in the morning, and went up to the top of the mountain, saying: Here we are, and we will go up to the place that Havayah said, for we have sinned.
And Moshe said: Why is this, you transgress the word of Havayah, and it shall not succeed?
Do not go up, for Havayah is not in your midst, and you shall not be struck down before your enemies.
For the Amaleki and the Kena'ani are there before you, and you shall fall by the sword, for you have turned from after Havayah, and Havayah will not be with you.
And they presumed to go up to the top of the mountain, and the Ark of the Covenant of Havayah and Moshe did not move from the midst of the camp.
And the Amaleki and the Kena'ani who dwell on that mountain came down, and struck them, and crushed them until Chormah.
And Havayah spoke to Moshe, saying:
Speak to the children of Yisroel, and say to them: When you come to the land of your dwellings, that I am giving to you.

And you shall make a fire offering to Havayah, a burnt offering or a peace offering, to fulfill a vow, or as a freewill gift, or at your appointed times, to make a pleasing aroma to Havayah, from the cattle or from the flock.
And the one who brings his offering to Havayah shall bring a meal offering, a tenth of fine flour mixed with a fourth of a hin of oil.
And wine for a libation, a fourth of a hin, you shall make with the burnt offering or for the peace offering, for one lamb.
Or for the ram you shall make a meal offering, two-tenths of fine flour mixed with a third of a hin of oil.
And wine for the libation, a third of a hin, you shall bring, a pleasing aroma to Havayah.
And when you make a young bull a burnt offering, or a peace offering, to fulfill a vow, or a peace offering to Havayah.
And he shall bring with the young bull a meal offering, three-tenths of fine flour mixed with a half of a hin of oil.
And you shall bring wine for the libation, a half of a hin, a pleasing-aroma fire offering to Havayah.
So shall be done for one bull, or for one ram, or for a lamb from the flock, or for a kid.
According to the number that you shall make, so you shall make for each, according to their number.
Every native shall do so, to bring a pleasing-aroma fire offering to Havayah.
And if a stranger shall dwell with you, or one who is in your midst for your generations, and he shall make a pleasing-aroma fire offering to Havayah, as you do, so he shall do.
Congregation, one statute shall be for you and for the stranger who dwells, an eternal statute for your generations; as you are, so the stranger shall be before Havayah.
One law and one ordinance shall be for you and for the stranger who dwells with you.
And Havayah spoke to Moshe, saying:
Speak to the children of Yisroel, and say to them: When you come to the land to which I am bringing you.
And it shall be, when you eat of the bread of the land, you shall set apart a gift to Havayah.
From the first of your dough you shall set apart a loaf, a gift; as the gift of the threshing floor, so you shall set it apart.
From the first of your dough you shall give to Havayah a gift, for your generations.
And if you err, and do not do all these commandments that Havayah spoke to Moshe.
All that Havayah commanded to you by the hand of Moshe, from the day Havayah commanded, and onward, for your generations.

And it shall be, if it was done unwittingly, hidden from the eyes of the congregation, then all the congregation shall make one young bull for a burnt offering, for a pleasing aroma to Havayah, and its meal offering and its libation, according to the ordinance, and one goat for a sin offering.

And the priest shall atone for all the congregation of the children of Yisroel, and it shall be forgiven to them, for it was unwitting, and they brought their offering, a fire offering to Havayah, and their sin offering before Havayah, for their unwitting act.
And it shall be forgiven to all the congregation of the children of Yisroel, and to the stranger who dwells among them, for it was unwitting for all the people.
And if one soul shall sin unwittingly, it shall bring a female goat in its first year for a sin offering.
And the priest shall atone for the soul who erred in sinning unwittingly before Havayah, to atone for him, and it shall be forgiven to him.
For the native among the children of Yisroel, and for the stranger who dwells among them, one law shall be for you, for the one who does unwittingly.
And the soul that shall act with a high hand, from the native and from the stranger, blasphemes Havayah, and that soul shall be cut off from among its people.
For he scorned the word of Havayah, and he broke His commandment; that soul shall surely be cut off; its iniquity is upon it.
And the children of Yisroel were in the wilderness, and they found a man gathering wood on the day of the Shabbos.
And those who found him gathering wood brought him to Moshe and to Aharon and to all the congregation.
And they placed him in custody, for it had not been explained what shall be done to him.
And Havayah said to Moshe: The man shall surely be put to death; all the congregation shall stone him with stones, outside the camp.
And all the congregation took him out, outside the camp, and stoned him with stones, and he died, as Havayah commanded Moshe.
And Havayah spoke to Moshe, saying:

Speak to the children of Yisroel, and say to them: And they shall make for themselves fringes on the corners of their garments, for their generations, and they shall place upon the fringe of the corner a sky-blue thread.

And it shall be for you for a fringe, and you shall see it, and remember all the commandments of Havayah, and do them; and you shall not stray after your heart and after your eyes, that you stray after them.
So that you shall remember, and do all My commandments, and be holy to your Elokim.
I am Havayah your Elokim, who brought you out of the land of Mitzrayim, to be Elokim for you; I am Havayah your Elokim.
And Korach son of Yitzhar, son of Kehat, son of Levi, took, and Datan and Aviram sons of Eliav, and On son of Pelet, sons of Reuven.
And they rose up before Moshe, and with them men of the children of Yisroel, two hundred and fifty, princes of the congregation, summoned to the assembly, men of renown.

And they gathered against Moshe and against Aharon, and said to them: Too much for you, for all the congregation, all of them are holy, and among them is Havayah; and why do you lift yourselves above the assembly of Havayah?
And Moshe heard, and fell upon his face.

And he spoke to Korach and to all his congregation, saying: In the morning Havayah will make known who is His, and who is holy, and bring him near to Him; and whom He shall choose, He will bring near to Him.
Do this: take for yourselves fire-pans, Korach and all his congregation.
And put in them fire, and place upon them incense before Havayah tomorrow; and it shall be, the man whom Havayah shall choose, he is the holy one; too much for you, sons of Levi.
And Moshe said to Korach: Hear now, sons of Levi.

Is it too little for you, that the Elokim of Yisroel separated you from the congregation of Yisroel, to bring you near to Him, to perform the service of the Tabernacle of Havayah, and to stand before the congregation to serve them?
And He brought you near, and all your brothers the sons of Levi with you, and do you seek the priesthood as well?
Therefore, you and all your congregation are gathered against Havayah; and Aharon, what is he, that you murmur against him?
And Moshe sent to call Datan and Aviram, sons of Eliav, and they said: We will not go up.
Is it too little that you brought us up from a land flowing with milk and honey, to kill us in the wilderness, that you rule over us, ruling?
And you have not brought us to a land flowing with milk and honey, and you have not given us a field-and-vineyard inheritance; will you blind the eyes of these men? We will not go up.
And Moshe was greatly angered, and he said to Havayah: Do not regard their offering; I have not taken one donkey from them, and I have not wronged one of them.
And Moshe said to Korach: You and all your congregation, be before Havayah, you and they and Aharon, tomorrow.
And each man take his fire-pan, and place incense upon them, and bring before Havayah, each man his fire-pan, two hundred and fifty fire-pans; and you and Aharon, each man his fire-pan.
And each man took his fire-pan, and put fire in them, and placed incense upon them, and stood at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting, with Moshe and Aharon.
And Korach gathered all the congregation against them, to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting, and the glory of Havayah appeared to all the congregation.
And Havayah spoke to Moshe and to Aharon, saying:
Separate yourselves from the midst of this congregation, and I will destroy them in a moment.
And they fell upon their faces, and said: El, Elokim of the spirits of all flesh, shall one man sin, and against all the congregation will You rage?
And Havayah spoke to Moshe, saying:
Speak to the congregation, saying: Go up from around the dwelling of Korach, Datan, and Aviram.
And Moshe rose, and went to Datan and Aviram, and the elders of Yisroel went after him.
And he spoke to the congregation, saying: Turn away now from beside the tents of these wicked men, and do not touch anything that is theirs, lest you perish in all their sins.

And they went up from around the dwelling of Korach, Datan, and Aviram; and Datan and Aviram came out, standing at the entrance of their tents, with their wives, and their sons, and their little ones.
And Moshe said: By this you shall know that Havayah sent me to do all these deeds, for they are not from my heart.
If these men die as all men die, and the visitation of all men is visited upon them, Havayah has not sent me.

And if Havayah creates a new creation, and the ground opens its mouth, and swallows them and all that is theirs, and they descend alive to the abyss, then you shall know that these men scorned Havayah.
And it was, as he finished speaking all these words, that the ground split that was beneath them.
And the earth opened its mouth, and swallowed them and their households, and all the men who were for Korach, and all the possessions.
And they descended, they and all that was theirs, alive to the abyss, and the earth covered them, and they were lost from the midst of the assembly.
And all Yisroel who were around them fled at their voice, for they said: Lest the earth swallow us.
And fire came out from Havayah, and consumed the two hundred and fifty men who offered the incense.
And Havayah spoke to Moshe, saying:
Say to Elazar son of Aharon the priest, and he shall lift the fire-pans from the midst of the burning, and scatter the fire far, for they have become holy.

The fire-pans of these sinners against their souls, they shall make them beaten sheets, a covering for the altar, for they brought them before Havayah, and they became holy; and they shall be for a sign to the children of Yisroel.
And Elazar the priest took the bronze fire-pans that the burned ones brought near, and they beat them as a covering for the altar.

A remembrance to the children of Yisroel, so that no stranger shall draw near, who is not of the descendants of Aharon, to burn incense before Havayah, and he shall not be as Korach and as his congregation, as Havayah spoke to him by the hand of Moshe.
And all the congregation of the children of Yisroel murmured on the next day against Moshe and against Aharon, saying: You have killed the people of Havayah.
And it was, when the congregation gathered against Moshe and against Aharon, and they turned to the Tent of Meeting, and behold, the cloud covered it, and the glory of Havayah appeared.
And Moshe and Aharon came before the Tent of Meeting.
And Havayah spoke to Moshe, saying:
Lift yourselves from the midst of this congregation, and I will destroy them in a moment; and they fell upon their faces.
